edges.reason: Constructor writes owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged account.
Ownable constructor assigns the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into the Ownable ownership transfer.
onlyOwner modifier gates Ownable.transferOwnership on msg.sender.
Ownable.transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into Claimable.transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates Claimable.transferOwnership on msg.sender.
Claimable.transferOwnership sets pendingOwner.
onlyPendingOwner modifier gates claimOwnership on msg.sender.
claimOwnership finalizes the ownership transfer into owner.
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner to zero.
Multiplicand a flows into the multiplication in MathUint.mul.
Multiplicand b flows into the multiplication in MathUint.mul.
mul performs c = a * b before verifying the overflow condition.
Minuend a flows into the subtraction in MathUint.sub.
Subtrahend b flows into the subtraction in MathUint.sub.
Addend a flows into the addition in MathUint.add.
Addend b flows into the addition in MathUint.add.
Minuend a flows into tolerantSub.
Subtrahend b flows into tolerantSub.
Array arr is iterated and summed in cvsquare.
Scale multiplies the accumulated sum of squares.
cvsquare calls MathUint.mul for squared deviations and scaling.
cvsquare calls MathUint.add to accumulate averages and sums.
cvsquare divides by avg and by (len - 1), risking division issues.
Authorization target address flows into authorizeAddress.
onlyOwner modifier gates authorizeAddress on msg.sender.
authorizeAddress writes AddressInfo (index/authorized) into addressInfos.
authorizeAddress advances the latestAddress list head.
De-authorization target address flows into deauthorizeAddress.
onlyOwner modifier gates deauthorizeAddress on msg.sender.
deauthorizeAddress flips the authorized flag in addressInfos.
max parameter bounds the returned authorized address list.
Function allocates and traverses an array sized by the caller-supplied max.
getLatestAuthorizedAddresses reads addressInfos while walking the list.
token parameter determines the external contract invoked by transferToken.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate transferToken on msg.sender.
transferToken performs an external call to ERC20.transferFrom on an untrusted token contract.
from parameter is the source of the delegated transfer.
to parameter is the destination of the delegated transfer.
value parameter is the transferred amount checked against 0.
lrcTokenAddress determines the LRC contract used for fee transfers.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate batchTransferToken on msg.sender.
batchTransferToken calls transferFrom on arbitrary token contracts inside its loop.
miner address is debited for LRC rewards.
feeRecipient receives the miner share of fees.
walletSplitPercentage drives the fee split arithmetic and is validated in range.
batch is parsed as packed words and must be a multiple of 7 in length.
batchTransferToken delegates fee distribution to splitPayFee.
token parameter selects the ERC20 contract used for fee transfers.
fee parameter is the divided amount in the split computation.
owner parameter is the payer and recipient-exclusion check.
feeRecipient parameter receives the miner fee.
walletFeeRecipient parameter receives the wallet fee.
walletSplitPercentage is multiplied to derive the wallet fee.
splitPayFee executes external transferFrom calls on the fee token contract.
addr parameter is looked up in the authorization mapping.
isAddressAuthorized reads the authorized flag from addressInfos.
orderHash indexes the cancelled mapping.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate addCancelled on msg.sender.
Adds cancelAmount to cancelled[orderHash] using safe math.
cancelAmount is added to the stored cancellation counter.
orderHash indexes the cancelledOrFilled mapping.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate addCancelledOrFilled on msg.sender.
Adds cancelOrFillAmount to cancelledOrFilled[orderHash] using safe math.
cancelOrFillAmount is added to the stored filled/cancelled counter.
Packed batch array supplies hash/amount pairs summed in a loop.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate batchAddCancelledOrFilled on msg.sender.
Loop accumulates amounts into cancelledOrFilled entries.
Cutoff timestamp t is written for the tx.origin account.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate setCutoffs on msg.sender.
tx.origin is used as the account key when storing cut-off timestamps.
setCutoffs writes the cutoffs mapping keyed by tx.origin.
Authorization/account identification relies on tx.origin, enabling phishing attacks.
tokenPair selects the per-pair cutoff entry.
Cutoff timestamp t is stored for the token pair.
onlyAuthorized/notSuspended modifiers gate setTradingPairCutoffs on msg.sender.
tx.origin is used as the owner key for trading-pair cutoffs.
setTradingPairCutoffs writes tradingPairCutoffs keyed by tx.origin.
Per-pair cutoff authorization depends on tx.origin rather than msg.sender.
owners array supplies the keys checked against both cutoff mappings.
tradingPairs array supplies the per-pair keys checked.
validSince timestamps are compared against stored cutoffs.
checkCutoffsBatch reads the global cutoffs mapping.
checkCutoffsBatch reads the tradingPairCutoffs mapping.
onlyOwner modifier gates suspend on msg.sender.
suspend sets the suspended flag to true.
onlyOwner modifier gates resume on msg.sender.
resume sets the suspended flag to false.
onlyOwner/isSuspended modifiers gate kill on msg.sender.
kill zeroes out the owner state variable permanently.
